main_text.p: fenestræ in Aquilonem vergant, perflabi-les. Quòd si veternosus sit æger, tum (præ-ter id quod clamoribus, ligaturis, frictioni-bus oxirrhodim syncipiti raso admoto ex-citandus est) noctem accensis candelis vin cere debet. Etenim lumine humores & spi-ritus ad exteriora revocatur. At ubi immo-deratis vigilijs cruciatur, utilissimum est, si vires suadent cubiculum, & lectulum sæpe mutare, aut lintea saltem & stragulas aceto, & aqua rosacea aspergere. Ægerpræte-rea vestimentis opprimendus non est, sed levibus tantum velandus. Quinetiam ci-bus refrigerantis naturæ sit, & stypticæ, qui & si exiguus exhibeatur, plurimum tamen alat, facilisq; concoctionis, acidis cöditus. Galenus horam prandij ac cœnæ pro consuetudine commendauit. Alij vero vesper-tinam matutinamq; præferunt. Et interdiu sæpe salutares confectiones, variosq; salu-berrimos potus cotinuo propinant. In hoc affectu elixa, & pinguia, quibus subito sa-tiatur stomachus damnantur à multis, & merito quidem, quoniam non tollenda est cibi appetentia, sed potius provocanda. Propterea caponum, aut perdicu assorum aqua stillaticia magnatibus est utilis: alijs vero

page.notes: Running head and text are set in capitals and small capitals; the V in CAVSAS is a vowel and is given as U. Possible missing spaces as printed: "Ægerpræte-rea", "vin cere" (printed "uin cere", no hyphen). "cotinuo" and "perdicu" are printed this way and are left as they are. "utilis:alijs" has no space after the colon in print; kept as printed. No marginal notes. Paragraph breaks are unclear in the scan: the text is treated as one paragraph because no line clearly ends short of the margin. The word "vero" at the foot is a catchword, not text.
